# What Stalwart 0.16 answers a member of three groups (shared mailboxes),
# taken from a real server with only the domain changed. Lines starting with
# "#" are comments.
CAPABILITY IMAP4rev2 IMAP4rev1 ENABLE SASL-IR LITERAL+ ID UTF8=ACCEPT AUTH=PLAIN AUTH=OAUTHBEARER AUTH=XOAUTH2
* NAMESPACE (("" "/")) (("Shared Folders" "/")) NIL
* LIST (\Trash) "/" "Deleted Items"
* LIST (\Drafts) "/" "Drafts"
* LIST () "/" "INBOX"
* LIST (\Junk) "/" "Junk Mail"
* LIST (\Sent) "/" "Sent Items"
